_comment: Supplementary / test-rig sensors not present in Sensors.xlsx. Loaded AFTER the Excel file; entries here win. 'multiplier' converts the raw 11-bit ALERT value to 'unit' and overrides the sensor-type default (needed when a station's configured Scale differs from the network default, e.g. Scale 1000 = millimetres vs the usual centimetres).

sensors.notes: Format F-4, Scale 1000, Offset 0mm, Sens 10mm. LoRa-derived height sent as millimetres: 0.896 m -> raw 896.
Format U-2, internal status block. 12.1 V -> raw 121.

sensors.description: DI3 digital input (Sens 1mm) - NOT the LoRa channel
sensors.notes: Shares the station address. Hamming distance 1 from 4079 - a single bit error in the river frame lands here, so treat a 4078 decode whose value matches 4079's as a probable ghost.
